description: Enumeration of all skills used across role packs. Source repo, target roles, and version tracked here.

skills.name: autoreview
skills.purpose: Structured second-model closeout after implementation. Run at every milestone. Explicitly not a builder self-check and not a multi-agent ship decision.
skills.install_note: Installed by uinaf/agents' own manifest-driven sync, not per-skill. sync.sh installs every skill in scripts/sync/skills.json and refuses to run from a dirty checkout or a branch behind upstream.

skills.name: autoplan
skills.install: included in CEO role pack AGENTS.md via sync-bootstrap.sh
skills.purpose: Decompose goals into ordered sub-issues before work begins.

skills.name: gstack-qa
skills.purpose: Real-browser QA verification for UI and WebGL changes.

skills.name: paper-search
skills.install: MCP plugin — available if Hugging Face MCP is connected
skills.purpose: Find relevant ML/AI papers and HuggingFace docs for research briefs.

skills.name: verify
skills.purpose: Builder-owned self-check before independent review. Produces ready for review / needs more work / blocked — never a ship decision.
skills.install_note: Installed by uinaf/agents' own manifest-driven sync, not per-skill. sync.sh installs every skill in scripts/sync/skills.json and refuses to run from a dirty checkout or a branch behind upstream.

update_policy.process: Knowledge company Researcher opens frontier-scan issue when upstream skill updates detected. Knowledge company Worker updates this file. CC distributes via sync-bootstrap.sh.
